jobs.title: Associate, Investments (Infrastructure Focus)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today!

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager - Terrace Group
jobs.description_text: ABOUT TERRACE GROUP HOLDINGS: Terrace Group Holdings is a Los Angeles–based real estate development firm focused exclusively on ground-up Class A self-storage assets in California. The firm sources, entitles, and builds climate-controlled storage facilities across Southern California’s highest-barrier markets. TGH currently has approximately $50 million of self-storage development under construction in Southern California, with a pipeline targeting $60 million or more of new development annually. The firm’s strategy combines disciplined site selection, deep municipal entitlement expertise, and hands-on development execution to deliver outsized risk-adjusted returns in a sector undergoing rapid institutional consolidation. TGH is a lean, founder-led organization where every team member has a direct line to decision-making and a tangible impact on the trajectory of the business. THE OPPORTUNITY: The Construction Project Manager’s responsibility is to supervise the field construction of a project and to complete the Work on schedule, within the budget and to the quality of workmanship specified.

The role will work with project teams to facilitate account set up, billing queries and other administrative concerns throughout the pre-development and construction process.

jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Manager, Accounting is responsible for overseeing the monthly and quarterly fund accounting processes for a publicly traded real estate fund. The role ensures the accuracy and completeness of fund-level accounting, consolidations, reconciliations, and cash and liquidity management activities. In addition, the position supports quarterly and annual GAAP-compliant financial reporting, analytical review and external reporting requirements, while providing financial insights to support management decision-making. jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Operations
jobs.description_text: ABOUT TERREVA RENEWABLES: Terreva Renewables is an industry-leading developer, owner, and operator of renewable natural gas (RNG) projects, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company leverages technology to capture methane gas from landfills and convert it to renewable natural gas. Its senior management team has over 40 years of collective experience developing RNG projects, as well as extensive additional experience in landfill gas-to-electricity projects, gas collection and control systems, and midstream oil and gas operations. Terreva’s current portfolio is comprised of seven assets – approximately 20,000 scfm of raw landfill gas flow and 3.5 million MMBtu’s per year of RNG production (2025E) – in operation and construction across North America. Terreva is a portfolio company under the management of CIM Group, LLC.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, governance, and operational success of a portfolio of business-critical platforms that support CIM’s debt investment and servicing operations. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, ensuring that systems, data, reporting, and operational workflows effectively support business objectives. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong analytical capabilities, sound business judgment, and the ability to translate complex operational needs into effective technology solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent communication skills, and a proven track record in product management or business systems analysis. Success Metrics: Reliable and effective operation of business-critical platforms, data, and reporting capabilities that support investment and operational objectives. Delivery of technology and process improvements that enhance efficiency, scalability, data quality, and user experience. Accurate, timely, and trusted reporting and analytics that enable informed business decision-making. Successful execution of strategic initiatives through effective collaboration with technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional partners. High stakeholder satisfaction demonstrated through strong partnership, responsiveness, and the ability to translate business needs into effective solutions.

jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Senior Data Scientist will be a pivotal member of our Enterprise Data Management team, playing a critical role in transforming raw, complex data into actionable intelligence that drives superior investment outcomes and operational efficiencies across the firm and its portfolio companies. The role is strategically positioned at the intersection of deep financial domain expertise and cutting-edge data science, requiring a proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, strategic recommendations for investment teams and senior leadership. jobs.description_text: About this Role: We’re looking for a hands-on Full Stack Software Engineer to help build the cloud and application services that power the next generation of Honda and Acura connected experiences. You’ll develop internal tools and engineering platforms that enable developers and QA engineers to build, test, deploy, and validate software more efficiently. Working across AWS and Google Cloud Platform, you’ll contribute to applications, backend services, APIs, automation, and cloud infrastructure that support our engineering teams. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving problems across the stack, and is enthusiastic about trying new technologies. You’ll work closely with developers, QA engineers, and other engineering teams to understand their workflows, automate manual processes, and build tools that make engineering teams more productive. The actual compensation package is determined by a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including demonstrated skills, depth and relevance of experience, and role-specific considerations. We welcome open conversations about compensation during initial discussions with all candidates.

Your job is to collect data and analyze current operating procedures to determine which continuous improvement process technique is the best for our situation. QA Engineer will also be responsible for the inception, maintenance and update of central directives pertaining to systematic problem solving, process quality engineering and Lean manufacturing principles within QMS. This role is multi-dimensional requiring interfacing with internal customers (Management, Engineering (SW & HW), and Manufacturing) to drive the corrective action culture and in due course transitioning into a lean process quality engineer optimizing the production system using lessons learned (LL) methodology and Lean/ Six sigma principles.

jobs.title: Staff RF Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Staff RF Engineer to our team. The ideal candidate has experience in board-level RF electronics design. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge RF hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for RF circuits and systems through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be proficient in board-level schematic design and PCB layout of RF circuits, and system-level communications concepts such as link budgets and modulation schemes. The work will include many aspects of phased array communication systems, including RF front-ends, frequency converters and synthesizers, filters, beamformers, power dividers, and phased array antennas. As a CesiumAstro hardware team member, you will be responsible for RF hardware designs from initial concept through requirements definition, part selection, detailed design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support of Cesium's products. Hardware design tasks will include block diagrams, detailed schematics, PCB layout and routing, simulations, and test design. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

Interns will primarily focus on either FPGA design or FPGA verification, based on project needs, experience, and interests. FPGA Design assignments may include developing and testing RTL for high-speed serial interfaces and data streams, digital processing cores, multiple clock domains, and management interfaces. FPGA Verification assignments may include developing testbenches and verification environments, creating test scenarios, generating constrained-random stimulus, checking expected behavior, debugging failures, and measuring verification coverage. Assignments will be determined by a mix of project availability and the interests of the successful candidates. Prior FPGA-specific coursework or experience is not required. We recognize that access to FPGA courses, development boards, commercial tools, and verification environments varies among universities. We are looking for candidates with a strong foundation in digital design or software-based verification concepts and an interest in applying those skills to FPGA development. We own designs from initial concept through part selection, schematic, layout, build, test, and delivery, all the way through in-orbit support. Designs encompass the spectrum of electronics design, including high-speed digital, power electronics, and RF hardware – often on the same board. We’re looking for summer interns to support our mission. Interns work side-by-side with design engineers: contributing to the company’s success is as high of a priority as learning and gaining experience. Interns are typically responsible for their own schematics and layouts as well as supporting analysis and hands-on lab work. In addition to insourced products you will also work with global contract manufacturers to ensure robust quality of millions of customer-facing devices that we ship directly to end users (Starlink dishes/user terminals, Wi-Fi routers, etc.). Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. jobs.description_text: LEARNING GUIDE Ad Astra is a private school and learner-driven community with the mission to encourage each person who enters its doors to find a calling and change the world. This department produces dies (also known as tools or molds) used in injection molding, high pressure die casting, and stamping. This role takes end-to-end ownership of equipment improvement projects from concept through design and implementation. The job is to maximize CNC, EDM, grinder, crane, and related equipment availability so die build rate is not set by a down machine. This role will be an ideal next career step if you seek a fast-paced/dynamic environment, thrive on solving difficult problems where resolutions have high impact, and love the challenge of building something from scratch.
